verdict.rationale: Building and sharing custom assistants is a fair question for a personal AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a single personal agent. The Vault stores materials and credentials, and Trusted People lets your agent talk to friends' agents; both are adjacent features, not tools to build or share assistants with their own instructions and knowledge.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
